summary: aḏnoṯi yaqiri belongs to the hearing-loss sense 2.
rationale: Both its ear subject and explicit hearing-loss translation instantiate dedicated sense 2 rather than generic heaviness.

summary: File the hearing-loss example under sense 2
rationale: aḏnoṯi yaqiri is explicitly translated as ears becoming hard of hearing. Stem I sense 2 is (i=aḏno) schwerhörig werden, whereas its current sense 1 is the general schwerfällig werden, schwerer werden.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (MAC Besim History of Bsorino/22)

data.turoyo: <...> Bəṯr mәd‿әḥzalle lu+ʕamo d Aspəs, d̥kətyo qadišo, myaqarre. <...>
data.translation: <...> After the people of Aspəs saw him, that he was a saint, they revered him. <...>

rationale: First II Preterit box; explicit plural agent and saint as understood object.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 1.6/6)

data.turoyo: <...> Omər: "Kubaʕno i kaččəkaṯe d msalmitulla. W d lə msalmitulla, u šuġlo gyoqər." <...>
data.translation: <...> Er sagte: Ich möchte, dass ihr dieses Mädchen herausgebt, und wenn ihr sie nicht herausgebt, dann wird die Sache ernst. <...>

rationale: Thin I Infectum sense 1; abstract affair becomes serious under a conditional threat.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC Besim History of Bsorino/21)

data.turoyo: Aṯi li+dayro, ḥəlle kəmyaqrile ġắlăbe. Lo+rḥəmle dәmyaqrile. <...>
data.translation: He came back to the monastery, he looked – they revere him a lot. He didn’t like that they revere him. <...>

rationale: One context covers the indicative and d-complement tokens; thin II Infectum cell.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC NE interview 1/11)

data.turoyo: <...> Koṯən gaban lu+ʕeḏo, kəmyaqrina u+ʕeḏo ġắlăbe. <...>
data.translation: <...> They come to us for the festival, we have a lot of respect for the festival. <...>

rationale: Festival as honoured object extends participant type; thin II Infectum cell.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (11/10)

data.turoyo: <...> Bəṯr me d ṯnəḥno, bdeli bi waḏ̣ifa, duleli lu profasor myaqro Halmut Ritter.
data.translation: <...> Dann, nachdem ich mich erholt hatte, ging ich an die Aufgabe, die mir der verehrte Professor Hellmut Ritter gestellt hatte.

rationale: Detransitive Part. Pass. in an ordinary narrative noun phrase, beyond the existing salutation.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (13/1)

data.turoyo: Ġalabe myaqro Prof. Dr. H. Ritter,
data.translation: Sehr geehrter Herr Prof. Dr. H. Ritter!

rationale: Degree-modified honorific with professional title; short independent thin-cell context.

summary: Move the embedded reference 78/194 out of the translation
before: The she-horse said to him: “ʕAmar!” – “What?” – “I have noticed that you became heavier by three pounds’ 78/194;

summary: I uses a zero-marked heavy/state-bearing subject; worsening illness adds the affected person with ʕal-. III makes another participant heavy (blood and bugs), contrasting with intransitive I.
The eleven myaqro occurrences are attributive or vocative honorifics, not assertions of a finite honouring event. Their placement follows the already attested II Detransitive Part. Pass. box.
II has no printed Detransitive sense list. Retain its inherited implicit label 1 for myaqro and ask editors to supply the corresponding gloss, rather than create a competing D1 numbering.

yaquro/yaqure/yaqurto denote heavy/severe properties, but the supplied adjective morphology does not establish Part act. inclusion under this glossary. Do not publish the proposed box on recall-oriented reader guesses.
PrS 24/40 matches the inherited shark quotation cited prs57/35; 78/194 and3/44 are also already quoted. Source numbering variants do not authorize citation replacements.
61/178: verify root and stem of koməqrat ruḥux aʕli. The superiority meaning is clear, but III mawqər versus a contracted II form is unresolved; no new numbered III sense is published.
Should lexical yaquro/yaqurto be admitted to a verbal box? Confirm classification and feminine yaqurto versus yaqərto before adding Part act. examples.
Supply the implicit II Detransitive sense 1 gloss for honoured myaqro; retain the existing Part. Pass. quotation meanwhile.
Verify PrS24/40 ~ inherited prs57/35 rather than automatically changing the citation.
An affair becoming serious extends the illness-intensification pattern to a social matter.
A festival can be honoured, as well as a priest or saint; same core meaning.
